design_description: A dramatic Venecia 07 design built around an Asian dragon theme, using a monochromatic white-to-black composition with selective turquoise/aqua accents. The upper section begins in clean white and pale grey, covered by a large tonal dragon-and-cloud illustration that behaves almost like an engraved background. Moving downward, the artwork progressively darkens through grey into deep charcoal and black, creating a strong vertical transition across the jersey. The main focal point appears on the lower-right front: a large, aggressive black dragon emerging diagonally upward from the hem. Its scales, horns and facial details are sharply defined, while turquoise flames and highlights around the mouth provide the only vivid colour and give the composition an almost supernatural energy. The black collar and sleeve cuffs frame the lighter upper body and connect visually with the darker lower section. Momuto branding and the Venecia 07 crest are kept primarily black and white, maintaining the controlled palette. Overall, it is a high-impact illustrative jersey built around contrast and storytelling: ethereal tonal dragons and clouds above, darkness building toward the hem, and a powerful foreground dragon emerging from the lower corner with turquoise fire as the signature accent.
